about_the_game:
Story

Want to graduate? Then fill up that Essence Bottle!

From the prestigious Haruka Girls' Academy comes a unique fox spirit girl—Hu Yingying—with her own refined sense of “Essence Aesthetics.”

Quantity over quality?

That’s no way for a proud fox spirit to live!

What Hu Yingying truly seeks is pure life essence infused with the high-level emotion called love! Using the mysterious power of the “MeowNet,” she tracks down a protagonist who has long given up on real-world romance.

In a whirlwind of teasing and counter-teasing, trial and error, the theory-savvy fox girl gradually savors the bittersweet flavor of love.

Will Hu Yingying succeed in absorbing the purest essence?

And what path will this cohabitation—filled with rising tension and blossoming feelings—lead them down?

Right now, this very moment—begin a steamy, thrilling, and just a bit beep-worthy romance with a fox spirit girl!

Character

Hu Yingying

A fox spirit who’s ditched the age-old seductive charms of her kin in favor of studying human-made romance techniques, all in pursuit of the purest essence.

Forget the old tales of scholars and seductresses—Yingying has her own romantic philosophy: she’ll only draw essence when her partner’s heart is truly pounding at 100%!

She can’t write human language, misuses idioms left and right, carries strange leaves etched with runes, and often does blush-inducing things regardless of the situation.

Her open and honest approach to love constantly throws the awkward protagonist off guard. But if it’ll make him smile—even just a little—she’ll give it her all.

Totally obsessed with the protagonist.

Her favorite thing in the world? The food he cooks.

Catchphrase: “Uguu~ Mr. Caretaker, feed me, please!”

Game Features

  • Dynamic Spine Live2D-style sprites

  • 4~6 hour short romance visual novel

  • Beautiful CG illustrations

  • Multiple endings

short_description: An uninvited fox spirit girl suddenly appears, determined to absorb the purest life essence—by having a romance that's both sultry and thrilling! And so begins a heart-pounding, sweat-inducing cohabitation life! This is a short romance visual novel guaranteed to make you smile!
